head: MONS peak finder app names the mountains you see, even offline
dek: MONS is a 2.99-dollar peak finder app for iPhone that labels the summits in your camera view, from more than a million peaks worldwide, and works offline once you download an area. It was #63 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 13 November.
details: You can also fly between peaks in 3D, take panorama photos with the peak names on them and share them or fly-in videos. It's a one-time purchase with no subscription or ads, and extra areas are included. It's made by Ostreum GmbH and also runs on Apple Silicon Macs and Apple Vision Pro.
where: iPhone (iOS 18 or later), Mac with Apple Silicon, Apple Vision; 2.99 dollars
means: If you hike or travel in the mountains, you can point your phone at a ridge and see each peak's name without a signal.
todo: Search MONS Peak Finder on the App Store and download your area before you lose reception.
